SELECT n_current, COUNT(*) AS member_ids FROM (SELECT member_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_current, SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_open FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH v AS (SELECT member_id, member_key, tier, valid_from, valid_to, is_current, join_date, LAG(valid_to) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_to, LAG(tier) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_tier FROM dim_member)
SELECT
 SUM(CASE WHEN prev_to IS NOT NULL AND prev_to >= valid_from THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overlaps,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prev_to IS NOT NULL AND prev_to + 1 < valid_from THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gaps,
 SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from > valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inverted,
 SUM(CASE WHEN is_current AND valid_from > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join,
 SUM(CASE WHEN is_current AND tier='Gold' AND valid_from > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_future,
 COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, COUNT(*) AS rows,
 SUM(CASE WHEN prev_tier = tier THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_tier_consecutive
FROM v
